summary: The iOS app locks every Expo SDK 57 managed package at the patch the installed expo expects, so the precompiled Expo frameworks link against a matching ExpoModulesCore. Builds 3 to 5 crashed on launch because ExpoImageManipulator 57.0.20 imported symbols ExpoModulesCore 57.0.8 did not export. A jest test fails on new drift.

desktop.reason: Only apps/mobile dependencies, one mobile import and a mobile test change.

nativeAndroid.reason: The native Android app in apps/android does not use the Expo packages.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data or key change; SecureStore and AsyncStorage keep their data across the patch bump.

updateRelease.notes: Native change: the fingerprint runtime version changes, so it ships in iOS build 6 and later OTAs reach only that binary.

automated: Mobile jest (expo-native-versions.test.ts fails on the old lock, passes on the new one) and tsc; expo-doctor clean except the local Xcode version.
dyld symbol scan of the build 5 IPA found the 8 missing ExpoModulesCore symbols; the same scan runs on the build 6 IPA.
notExercised: Launching build 6 on an iPhone or a simulator.
